result.summary: The home tab appears selected in the content but the bottom nav highlights Profile instead, and the Home icon/label use a weak inactive gray that looks faded.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows Profile as the selected tab (green icon and label) while the screen is clearly the Home feed (location, search, category chips, restaurant lists). Home is shown as unselected.
issues.suggestion: Keep tab selection in sync with the current screen: highlight Home when this feed is visible, and only highlight Profile on the profile screen.

issues.description: The unselected Home icon and label are a very light gray and look washed out next to Search and Orders.
issues.suggestion: Use a stronger inactive color so all unselected tabs are equally readable and Home does not look disabled.
